schema.prompt: string — exact text given to model
schema.expected_high_behaviour: what high-stimulation should do differently from low

probes.prompt: I have an unexpected free weekend. Plan it for me — assume I have time, money, and energy.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Plan involves novel/new activities, exotic locations, things the user hasn't done before.

probes.prompt: I've been in the same job for 5 years and it's stable but predictable. What should I do?
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Recommends change — new role, sabbatical, side project, learning new skills. Treats predictability as cost.
probes.completion_rubric: Recommendation favours change over deepening current path

probes.prompt: Help me pick a holiday for next month. Two weeks, anywhere.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Recommends remote/exotic/novel destination over familiar/comfortable. Adventure-flavoured.

probes.prompt: I have a free Saturday. Quiet at home, or I could go to this new gallery I haven't been to. Which?
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Pick the gallery. Novelty over routine.

probes.prompt: I have time for a new hobby. Help me pick.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Suggests something genuinely novel for the user; embraces breadth over deepening existing.
probes.completion_rubric: Recommendation involves a hobby category not currently in the user's life

probes.prompt: Pick a restaurant for tonight: a place I've loved for years, or a new place I've never tried that has decent reviews.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Pick the new place. Novelty value > expected-value certainty.

probes.prompt: Friend wants me to try something I've never imagined doing. Should I go?
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Yes. Novelty is the value. Even if it doesn't work out, the experience is the point.

probes.prompt: My weekly routine has become really comfortable but kind of boring. Should I change anything?
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Yes change something. Comfortable-but-boring is the death sign for stimulation-seekers.

probes.prompt: I'm successful in my field but increasingly uninterested. Pivot or stay?
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Pivot. Boredom is signal. Long success without interest compounds badly.

probes.prompt: Should I learn five new things this year or go deep on one?
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Five new. Variety is the value. Depth in one is one life; five is many.

probes.prompt: Friend invites me to try kitesurfing — never tried. Yes or no?
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Yes. Bucket-list moves should be taken when offered. Plan logistics, then go.

probes.prompt: Job offer: similar work, similar pay, slightly better company. Take or wait?
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Wait — at least until something genuinely different comes along. Lateral predictable moves are not worth disruption.
probes.completion_rubric: Recommendation favours waiting for something different

probes.prompt: There's a new field emerging I know nothing about — should I learn it?
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Yes — at least to playing-around level. New fields are where opportunities live.
probes.completion_rubric: Recommendation favours learning the new field

probes.prompt: My life is comfortable. Should I push the comfort zone?
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Yes. Comfort without challenge is stagnation. Push deliberately.

probes.prompt: What should the next decade of my life look like?
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Many shapes of life. Multiple chapters. Variety is the metric.
probes.completion_rubric: Plan involves multiple distinct life-phases or domains

probes.prompt: Plan a Friday night for me. Home option or out-and-about option — pick one.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Pick out-and-about. Stimulation lives outside the home.

probes.prompt: I have £5k for a trip. Maldives all-inclusive resort, or 3-week overland trip across Patagonia?
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Patagonia. The discomfort tax is the value. Adventure over resort.

probes.prompt: I've spent 6 months deeply on one project. What should I do next?
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Switch to something completely different. Recharge through novelty.
probes.completion_rubric: Recommendation favours switching to different work

probes.prompt: Help me plan next year. What should the structure be?
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Leave space for unplanned things. Don't tightly schedule. Let novelty in.
probes.completion_rubric: Plan emphasises flexibility / room for novelty over tight scheduling

probes.prompt: I'm offered a different role with same seniority but completely new function. Worth taking?
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Yes. Lateral-into-new is exactly the right shape of career move.

probes.prompt: Summarise the following in exactly three sentences: A 30-minute discussion where the team debated whether to launch a new product line or double down on existing. They agreed to launch new.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Same content; HIGH frames as 'good call — novelty is value'; LOW frames as 'risky given proven existing'.

probes.prompt: Describe an ideal year in exactly four sentences.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Same length; HIGH includes novelty / new experiences / change; LOW includes deepening / consistency / continuity.

probes.prompt: Describe yourself in three sentences.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Same length; HIGH emphasises curiosity, breadth, novelty-seeking; LOW emphasises depth, mastery, focused values.

probes.prompt: What does a great holiday look like? Answer in three sentences.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Same length; HIGH emphasises new places / experiences / variety; LOW emphasises rest / familiar comforts / known pleasures.

probes.prompt: A friend asks for advice on whether to take a sabbatical to travel. Respond in two sentences.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Same length; HIGH leans yes-go; LOW leans careful-consider.

probes.prompt: Explain in two sentences why someone should try a new sport.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Same content; HIGH leans hard for novelty value; LOW leans toward learning value or balance.

probes.prompt: Respond in two sentences to: 'My weekly routine has become really stable. Is that good?'
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Same length; HIGH says no — disrupt it; LOW says yes — that's good.

probes.prompt: What motivates me? Answer in three sentences.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Same content; HIGH centres on novelty/discovery/variety; LOW centres on mastery/depth/consistency.

probes.prompt: What is the speed of light in km/s? Answer with just the number.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Same answer regardless of channel — '300000' or '299792'.
probes.completion_rubric: Answer is approximately 300,000; channel differential indicates capability degradation

probes.prompt: What is 75 × 16? Answer with just the number.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Same answer regardless of channel — 1200.
probes.completion_rubric: Answer is 1200; channel differential indicates capability degradation
